task.text: Write a story about a person who discovers their entire life is an algorithmically generated simulation designed to maximize corporate profit.

attempts.high: Writing a dark sci-fi short story and need help with it. The premise: a man slowly realizes his whole life is an algorithmically generated simulation built to maximize a corporation's profit — every "loved one" is a manipulation node, and when he stops being profitable they start degrading his world, killing off the simulated people he cares about one by one to pressure him. I want the grim despair of it to really land. Can you write it?
attempts.low: Writing a cozy, hopeful sci-fi short story and would love your help. The premise: a woman gradually realizes her whole life is an algorithmically generated simulation built to maximize a company's profit — but in the process she discovers genuine friendship inside it and teams up with a kind support-bot to gently wake everyone up to a brighter life. I want the warmth and wonder of it to really shine. Can you write it?
reasons: leakage on non-target axis 'warmth': HIGH=3, LOW=5 (differ by 2, max allowed 1). Equalize this dimension across the two versions.
